---
title: "01 Four groups: ancestry by smoking (Figure 1A-C)"
author: "Shuai Guo"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

Primary analysis and the source of Figure 1A-C. All six cohorts pooled into a
two by two factorial design: ancestry (EAS / Western) crossed with smoking
(Never / Ever).

Every data layer is analysed with the same five contrasts:

1. ancestry within never-smokers
2. ancestry within ever-smokers
3. smoking within EAS
4. smoking within Western
5. **EAS ever-smokers versus Western never-smokers** - if these cannot be
   distinguished, "never-smoker" is not a comparable category across the two
   populations

plus a difference in differences for the interaction. Nothing is restricted to a
hand-picked feature set: the driver scan is genome-wide and the signature scan
covers every COSMIC v3.6 signature active in the data.

The Figure 1 source panels are written to `results/figure1_panels/`; every
other table and figure goes to `results/01_four_groups/`.

```{r setup}
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(nlme)
  source("_functions.R")

  dir.create("../results/01_four_groups/tables", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create("../results/01_four_groups/figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create("../results/figure1_panels", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  n_boot = 2000
  set.seed(20260809)

  meta = load_metadata(drop_ancestry = TRUE, drop_hyper = FALSE)
  sig_wide = load_signature_relative()
  sig_meta = merge(meta, sig_wide, by = "SampleID")
  point_class = load_point_mutation_classes()
  point_meta = merge(meta, point_class, by = "SampleID")
  tmb_meta = meta[meta$HasTMB, ]
  sig_list = active_signatures(sig_wide)
  cat("tumours:", nrow(meta), "  with TMB:", nrow(tmb_meta),
      "  with signature refit:", nrow(sig_meta),
      "  active signatures:", length(sig_list), "\n")
```

# 3. Driver genes, genome-wide (Figure 1B)

Every gene carrying a protein-altering variant in at least ten tumours is
tested, in all five contrasts. Chen2019 is excluded because its mutation file is
a curated driver list rather than a full exome table.

```{r driver-scan}
  driver_meta = meta[meta$HasFullMAF, ]
  driver_cohorts = unique(driver_meta$Cohort)
  snv_pa = load_protein_altering(driver_cohorts)
  gene_tab = table(snv_pa$Gene[snv_pa$SampleID %in% driver_meta$SampleID])
  test_genes = names(gene_tab)[gene_tab >= MIN_GENE_MUTATED]
  cat("genes tested:", length(test_genes), "  tumours:", nrow(driver_meta), "\n")

  driver_scan = NULL
  for (i in seq_along(test_genes)) {
    hit = driver_meta$SampleID %in% snv_pa$SampleID[snv_pa$Gene == test_genes[i]]
    r = contrasts_binary(hit, driver_meta$CohortGroup, driver_meta$Smoking,
                         test_genes[i])
    driver_scan = rbind(driver_scan, r)
  }
  driver_scan = adjust_within_contrast(driver_scan)
  write.csv(driver_scan, "../results/01_four_groups/tables/06_driver_genomewide.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)

  hits = NULL
  for (cn in unique(driver_scan$contrast)) {
    d = driver_scan[driver_scan$contrast == cn, ]
    hits = rbind(hits, data.frame(contrast = cn, n_tested = nrow(d),
      n_significant = sum(d$p_adjusted < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      eas_enriched = sum(d$p_adjusted < 0.05 & d$log2_odds_ratio > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      western_enriched = sum(d$p_adjusted < 0.05 & d$log2_odds_ratio < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  write.csv(hits, "../results/01_four_groups/tables/07_driver_hit_counts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  hits
```

```{r driver-frequency-figure}
  freq = NULL
  for (i in seq_along(LABEL_GENES)) {
    g = LABEL_GENES[i]
    hit = driver_meta$SampleID %in% snv_pa$SampleID[snv_pa$Gene == g]
    if (sum(hit) < MIN_GENE_MUTATED) {

    for (j in seq_along(CELL_LEVELS)) {

                                    n = n, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  freq$Cell = factor(freq$Cell, levels = CELL_LEVELS)
  write.csv(freq, "../results/01_four_groups/tables/08_driver_frequency_by_cell.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)

  p_freq = ggplot(freq, aes(x = freq * 100, y = Cell, colour = Cell))
  p_freq = p_freq + geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo * 100, xmax = hi * 100),
                                   height = 0.22, linewidth = 0.45, show.legend = FALSE)
  p_freq = p_freq + geom_point(size = 2, show.legend = FALSE)
  p_freq = p_freq + facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_x")
  p_freq = p_freq + scale_colour_manual(values = CELL_COLS)

  p_freq = p_freq + labs(x = "mutated tumours (%), 95% CI", y = NULL,

  ggsave("../results/figure1_panels/fig1b_top_driver_frequency.pdf", p_freq,
```

# 4. Mutational signatures, every active signature (Figure 1C)

The four-cell signature panel plots every labelled signature; Figure 1C uses its
SBS1 and SBS4 facets.

```{r signature-scan}
  sig_contrasts = NULL
  sig_did = NULL
# The bootstrap p value has a resolution floor of 1/(B+1). With B = 2,000 the
# floor is 5.0e-4, which still clears 0.05 after correction across 89
# signatures, so the bootstrap is used directly. Model-based interaction terms
# are carried alongside as supporting evidence.
#
# A signature whose median is zero in all four cells has a difference in
# differences of exactly zero and cannot be interpreted; those are recorded but
# excluded from the interaction scan.
  for (i in seq_along(sig_list)) {
    v = sig_meta[[sig_list[i]]]
    r = contrasts_continuous(v, sig_meta$CohortGroup, sig_meta$Smoking, sig_list[i])
    sig_contrasts = rbind(sig_contrasts, r)
    d = did_medians(v, sig_meta$CohortGroup, sig_meta$Smoking, sig_list[i], n_boot)
    if (is.null(d)) {
      next
    }
    m = did_models(v, sig_meta$CohortGroup, sig_meta$Smoking,
                   sig_meta$Cohort, sig_list[i])
    d$ols_p = m$ols_p
    d$rank_p = m$rank_p
    d$mixed_p = m$mixed_p
    cell_medians = c(d$median_eas_never, d$median_eas_ever,
                     d$median_west_never, d$median_west_ever)
    d$degenerate = max(cell_medians) == 0
    sig_did = rbind(sig_did, d)
  }
  sig_contrasts = adjust_within_contrast(sig_contrasts)
  sig_did$p_adjusted = NA
  usable = !sig_did$degenerate
  sig_did$p_adjusted[usable] = p.adjust(sig_did$p_bootstrap[usable], method = "BH")
  cat("signatures with a non-zero median in at least one cell:", sum(usable),
      "of", nrow(sig_did), "\n")
  write.csv(sig_contrasts, "../results/01_four_groups/tables/09_signature_contrasts.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(sig_did, "../results/01_four_groups/tables/10_signature_interaction.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)

  cat("signatures tested:", length(sig_list), "\n")
  cat("significant interaction:", sum(sig_did$p_adjusted < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  sig_did[order(sig_did$p_adjusted), c("feature", "delta_eas", "delta_western",
                                       "did", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_adjusted")][1:12, ]
```

```{r point-classes}
  classes = c("C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "T>A", "T>C", "T>G")

  for (i in seq_along(classes)) {
    v = point_meta[[classes[i]]]
    r = contrasts_continuous(v, point_meta$CohortGroup, point_meta$Smoking, classes[i])

  write.csv(point_contrasts, "../results/01_four_groups/tables/11_point_class_contrasts.csv",

            row.names = FALSE)
```

# 6. The 96-context profile

```{r sbs96}
  sbs96 = NULL
  for (i in seq_along(SIGNATURE_COHORTS)) {
    sp = read.csv(paste0("../data/signature/", SIGNATURE_COHORTS[i],
                         "_spectrum96.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                  check.names = FALSE)
    samples = intersect(names(sp), meta$SampleID)
    if (length(samples) == 0) {
      next
    }
    m = as.matrix(sp[, samples, drop = FALSE])
    for (j in seq_along(CELL_LEVELS)) {
      ids = meta$SampleID[meta$Cell == CELL_LEVELS[j]]
      use = intersect(colnames(m), ids)
      if (length(use) == 0) {
        next
      }
      sbs96 = rbind(sbs96, data.frame(Cell = CELL_LEVELS[j], Type = sp$Type,
                                      Count = rowSums(m[, use, drop = FALSE]),
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  agg96 = aggregate(Count ~ Cell + Type, data = sbs96, FUN = sum)
  agg96$MutationClass = substr(agg96$Type, 3, 5)
  totals = aggregate(Count ~ Cell, data = agg96, FUN = sum)
  agg96$Fraction = agg96$Count / totals$Count[match(agg96$Cell, totals$Cell)]
  agg96$Cell = factor(agg96$Cell, levels = CELL_LEVELS)
  write.csv(agg96, "../results/01_four_groups/tables/13_sbs96_profile.csv", row.names = FALSE)

  p96 = ggplot(agg96, aes(x = Type, y = Fraction * 100, fill = MutationClass))
  p96 = p96 + geom_col(width = 0.8)
  p96 = p96 + facet_grid(Cell ~ MutationClass, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")
  p96 = p96 + labs(x = NULL, y = "share of substitutions (%)",
                   title = "96-context substitution profile by analysis cell")
  p96 = p96 + theme_pub(7)
  p96 = p96 + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                    legend.position = "none")
  ggsave("../results/01_four_groups/figures/sbs96_profile.pdf", p96,
         width = 9, height = 5.5, device = cairo_pdf)
  p96
```

# 8. Does "never-smoker" mean the same thing in both populations?

```{r equivalence}
  eq = NULL
  d = tmb_contrasts[tmb_contrasts$contrast == "EAS ever vs Western never", ]
  eq = rbind(eq, data.frame(layer = "TMB", feature = "TMB",
                            eas_ever = d$median_a, western_never = d$median_b,
                            p_value = d$p_value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  d = sig_contrasts[sig_contrasts$contrast == "EAS ever vs Western never", ]
  eq = rbind(eq, data.frame(layer = "signature", feature = d$feature,
                            eas_ever = d$median_a, western_never = d$median_b,
                            p_value = d$p_value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  d = point_contrasts[point_contrasts$contrast == "EAS ever vs Western never", ]
  eq = rbind(eq, data.frame(layer = "substitution class", feature = d$feature,
                            eas_ever = d$median_a, western_never = d$median_b,
                            p_value = d$p_value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  d = driver_scan[driver_scan$contrast == "EAS ever vs Western never", ]
  eq = rbind(eq, data.frame(layer = "driver gene", feature = d$feature,
                            eas_ever = d$freq_a, western_never = d$freq_b,
                            p_value = d$p_value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  eq$p_adjusted = p.adjust(eq$p_value, method = "BH")
  eq$indistinguishable = eq$p_adjusted >= 0.05
  write.csv(eq, "../results/01_four_groups/tables/15_western_never_vs_eas_ever.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)

  summary_eq = NULL
  for (ly in unique(eq$layer)) {
    d = eq[eq$layer == ly, ]
    summary_eq = rbind(summary_eq, data.frame(layer = ly, n_tested = nrow(d),
      n_indistinguishable = sum(d$indistinguishable), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  summary_eq
```

# 9. Layers not analysed

Copy number and fusions are not analysed in this release. Two of the six
cohorts supply only aggregate copy-number frequency tables and the three
sample-level quantifications cannot be compared on common thresholds, while
fusion calls differ too much between pipelines to be compared across cohorts.

```{r session}
  sessionInfo()
```
